title: write the outline
oneLiner: One page: sections and headings only, no script.
summary: `knowledge.md` -> `videos/<key>/outline.md`, following `OUTLINE-INSTRUCTIONS.md`. One screen: the intro's hook/credibility/roadmap as bullets, the body sections numbered with one line each, and one line on how the conclusion is organised. No spoken copy, no lanes, no tables. Added 2026-08-23 - before it, the first document written was the full beat draft, so the owner could only judge direction by reading a finished script.
